sn38.7:1.1: Vedanā vedanā ti āvuso Sāriputta vuccati ||
sn38.7:1.5: sukhā vedanā dukkhā vedanā adukkhamasukhā vedanā
sn38.7:1.7: Atthi panāvuso maggo atthi paṭipadā etāsaṃ vedanānam pariññāyāti || ||
sn38.7:1.8: Atthi kho āvuso maggo atthi patipadā etāsaṃ vedanānam pariññāyāti || || 5
sn38.7:1.9: Katamo panāvuso maggo katamā paṭipadā etāsaṃ vedanānam pariññāyāti || ||
sn38.7:1.10: Ayam eva kho āvuso ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo etāsaṃ vedanānam pariññāyā || seyyathīdaṃ ||
sn38.7:1.12: ayaṃ kho āvuso maggo ayam paṭipadā etāsam vedanānam pariññāyāti || || 6
sn38.7:1.13: Bhaddako āvuso maggo bhaddakā paṭipadā etāsaṃ vedanānam pariññāya ||
